AMENDED AND RESTATED LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Amended and Restated License Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into by and between Generic Biotech Holdings, Inc. and a third-party licensor, and amends and restates in its entirety the prior license agreement between the parties governing certain intellectual property rights related to GBH-101.
